$comment: Rich metadata sidecar merged into the generated MCP tool manifest. Keys are tool names. Each entry may set: category, description, examples, and params (per-parameter description/type/enum/default). Auto-inferred schema is used as the base; values here override it. Not every tool needs an entry.

create_scene.description: Create a new .tscn scene file with a chosen root node type. Use CharacterBody2D/Node2D for 2D, Node3D/CharacterBody3D for 3D, Control for UI. Always follow with add_node and save_scene.

path.description: res:// path for the new scene, e.g. res://scenes/player.tscn

root_type.description: Root node class name, e.g. Node2D, CharacterBody2D, Node3D, Control

add_node.description: Add a child node of any Godot class to the currently edited scene. Properties accept Godot literal strings like 'Vector2(10, 20)' or 'Color(1,0,0,1)'.

parent_path.description: Path of the parent node relative to root, '.' for root

type.description: Node class name, e.g. Sprite2D, CollisionShape2D, Camera3D

properties.description: Optional dict of property -> Godot literal value string

update_property.description: Set a single property on a node. Values use Godot literal syntax: 'Vector2(x, y)', 'Color(r,g,b,a)', 'true', '3.14', or a res:// path for resources.

dimension.description: 2D or 3D collision (auto-detected from node when omitted)

create_particles.description: Create a 2D (GPUParticles2D) or 3D (GPUParticles3D) particle node. Combine with apply_particle_preset for instant effects.

is_3d.description: true for GPUParticles3D, false for GPUParticles2D

setup_lighting.description: Add a 3D light. Use light_type for a raw light or preset for a tuned setup.

export_project.description: Headless-export the project for a preset (actually runs the export, producing the binary). For Android/iOS prefer deploy_to_android / export_ios.

preset_name.description: Export preset name from Project > Export

debug.description: Export a debug build (true) or release (false)

deploy_to_android.description: Full Android pipeline: headless export APK -> adb install -r -> optional launch. Requires an Android export preset and a connected device (list_android_devices).

skip_export.description: Reuse an existing APK instead of re-exporting

setup_camera_2d.description: Add or configure a Camera2D with zoom, limits, smoothing and drag margins. Attach as a child of the player to follow it.

zoom.description: Zoom as 'Vector2(x, y)' or number; >1 zooms in

setup_parallax.description: Create a ParallaxBackground with one or more ParallaxLayer children for scrolling backgrounds.

layers.description: Array of layer dicts: { texture, motion_scale, name }

add_animated_sprite.description: Add an AnimatedSprite2D and build a SpriteFrames resource from a sprite sheet (hframes x vframes) or a list of textures.

sheet_texture.description: res:// path to a sprite sheet texture

hframes.description: Horizontal frame count in the sheet

vframes.description: Vertical frame count in the sheet

fps.description: Animation speed in frames per second

setup_light_2d.description: Add 2D lighting: PointLight2D / DirectionalLight2D, optionally a CanvasModulate for global darkness. Use for day/night and atmosphere.

texture.description: res:// path to the light texture (required for PointLight2D glow)

canvas_modulate.description: Also add a CanvasModulate to darken the scene

canvas_modulate_color.description: Ambient darkness color when canvas_modulate is true

create_tileset.description: Create a TileSet resource with an atlas source from a texture, sized by tile dimensions. Use before tilemap_set_cell / tilemap_fill_rect.

path.description: res:// path for the .tres TileSet, e.g. res://tilesets/world.tres

texture.description: res:// path to the atlas texture

tile_size.description: Tile size as 'Vector2i(w, h)' or single int

tilemap_node_path.description: Optional: assign the created TileSet to this TileMapLayer node

setup_2d_platformer_player.description: High-level: build a ready-to-play 2D platformer player (CharacterBody2D + Sprite2D + CollisionShape2D + movement script with gravity/jump/run, wired to input actions). Ideal as the first step of a one-prompt 2D game.

scene_path.description: res:// path to create the player scene

sprite_texture.description: Optional res:// path to the player texture

setup_csg.description: Add a CSG primitive (great for fast 3D level blockouts before final meshes).

add_multimesh.description: Add a MultiMeshInstance3D for high-performance instancing (forests, crowds) - critical for mobile performance.

setup_3d_character.description: High-level: build a ready-to-play 3D character (CharacterBody3D + mesh + CollisionShape3D + follow camera + third-person movement script). Ideal as the first step of a one-prompt 3D game.

scene_path.description: res:// path for the character scene

texture.description: res:// path to the decal albedo texture

get_ios_preset_info.description: Read iOS export preset metadata (bundle id, export path) from export_presets.cfg.

export_ios.description: Headless-export an iOS Xcode project/IPA for a preset. iOS builds require macOS + Xcode; on other OSes returns a clear suggestion.

apply_mobile_preset.description: Apply mobile-optimized project settings in one call: renderer, stretch mode, VRAM texture compression (ETC2/ASTC), anti-aliasing and an FPS cap. Run early when targeting phones.

vram_compression.description: Import textures with mobile VRAM compression

fps_cap.description: Max FPS to save battery (0 = uncapped)

setup_touch_controls.description: Add an on-screen touch control rig (virtual joystick + action buttons) on a CanvasLayer and wire it to input actions. Makes a desktop game playable on phones.

buttons.description: Array of action button dicts: { action, text, position }

apply_safe_area.description: Adjust a Control (typically the HUD root) to respect the device safe area (notch/rounded corners) using DisplayServer.get_display_safe_area at runtime via an attached helper script.

node_path.description: Control node to constrain to the safe area

optimize_for_mobile.description: Analyze the current scene/project for mobile performance (draw calls, node count, uncompressed textures, heavy effects) and return prioritized recommendations; can auto-apply safe fixes.

get_godot_guide.description: Return curated Godot MCP workflow guidance for a topic (start here before building). Use overview first, then quickstart-2d / quickstart-3d / mobile as needed.
